name: figma-interaction-doc-engine
description: Deterministic engine that turns v2 interaction-doc Markdown into Figma documents via figma-console-mcp. 0.4.3: bridge liveness is a plugin roundtrip (not socket state), render preflight on by default, per-exec client-side timeout returns V2_BRIDGE_NO_REPLY (no 60s host self-heal restart), bridge snapshot in result, third-state bridge diagnostics.
